metrics.entryMs: selection including queue, download/decode and consumer display-object handover; excludes later first-render work
metrics.memory: Runtime.getHeapUsage for the main renderer V8 isolate; observed samples plus explicit post-GC checkpoints
metrics.knownPayload: RGBA estimate, accepted AudioBuffer sample bytes and HTML5 Blob bytes; not total renderer memory
metrics.bodyBytes: completed static-server HTTP response bodies; excludes request/response headers and physical wire overhead
